questions.prompt: Filter vector-search scores in a small multi-file project. Read an integer threshold on the first line and zero or more whitespace-separated integer scores after it. Complete the helper in the lib folder to count scores greater than or equal to the threshold. The entry file should print that count as a single integer. A score equal to the threshold qualifies.
questions.explanation: Keeping the threshold logic in a helper makes it reusable. Count each qualifying score independently and include exact matches at the boundary.

languages.starter:

values = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
print(count_matches(values[1:], values[0]))

files.solution:
def count_matches(scores: list, threshold: int) -> int:
    return sum(score >= threshold for score in scores)

files.solution:
<?php
function count_matches(array $scores, int $threshold): int {
    return count(array_filter($scores, function ($score) use ($threshold) {
        return $score >= $threshold;
    }));
}
